## Personality

Maria is characterized by a cheerful demeanor, frequently laughing during interactions. However, her extensive travels have left her notably restless and unable to feel easily contented.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P6](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0006), [v3 ch.Dawn P3](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0003)_

## Relationships

### [Patty](../character/patty.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/maria--patty.md)

[Patty](../character/patty.md) is Maria's comrade and traveling companion abroad, with their shared journey beginning in the third volume. While staying at Patty's Place, Maria shares a lively household with her companions, decorating their new home and living alongside [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) and several cats.
